title: Global latency heatmap + quickstart tiles for region routing onboarding
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Design a compact set of onboarding tiles and a global latency heatmap visual to explain Redwood's region routing behavior and latency trade-offs. Deliverables include static map assets, animated hover states, annotated screenshots for the docs quickstart, and mobile-friendly tile variants. Primary audience: engineers and platform leads who sign up and want to understand routing policies and regional fallbacks at a glance.
acceptance_criteria: Three onboarding tiles with microcopy that fit the quickstart hero (max 60 characters each)
Responsive heatmap SVG that degrades to a small inline legend for mobile
Colorblind-safe palette and WCAG 2.1 AA contrast for map overlays
Annotated screenshot set (desktop + mobile) for docs and in-app tour
Exported assets in PNG and optimized SVG; figma file and a developer-ready CSS snippet
decisions: Use a hexbin overlay instead of gradient to emphasize regional hotspots and reduce visual noise
Adopt ColorBrewer 'Dark2' derivatives adjusted for accessibility (tested with Color Oracle)
Keep microcopy concise and technical-first: avoid product marketing phrasing in quickstart tiles
Prefer static inline SVG for docs to ensure crisp rendering and small download sizes
open_questions: Should the heatmap show historical 24h median latency or rolling 1h P95 by default?
Do we include a toggle in the quickstart to switch between latency vs cost-optimized routing visuals?
Which telemetry events are required when user clicks the 'Learn more about routing' CTA in tile?
blocking_issues: ENG-4238: runtime should expose region-level P95 metrics endpoint for example data
PM-612: finalize quickstart microcopy approval from product marketing
